# Tools Core

> Shared dependency injection interfaces for Unity tools: `IMonoBehaviourInjector`, `IPrefabInstantiator` and `ToolInjectionServices`. Lets Unity packages work with Fast IoC, Zenject, VContainer or no container (falls back to `Object.Instantiate`). Ships optional VContainer (`builder.UseToolsCore()`) and Zenject (`ToolsCoreInstaller`) adapters that compile only when the container is present, and `IInjectingPrefabInstantiator` so tools don't inject twice. Required by Fast IoC. No dependencies. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.
